strings.crash_recovery_body: Observation is paused. This diagnostic stays on your phone until you copy it.
strings.data_channel_observation_description: Shown while a Journey or Sit is observing.
strings.data_channel_presence_description: Shown while this phone is broadcasting presence tokens for friends.
strings.data_notification_session_text: Receiving Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi broadcasts. Tap to open.
strings.data_notification_session_geotag: Receiving broadcasts. Phone location is on for this session.
strings.data_notification_presence_text: This phone is broadcasting rotating tokens that only approved friends can recognise.
strings.data_notification_session_movement: Observing shared movement with phone location. Route saving is off.
strings.headline_persistent_new: New radio observed for a long time
strings.export_lead: Exports are privacy-reduced by default: coarse coordinates, hashed identifiers, no notes, 15-minute time buckets, no friend presence.
strings.export_raw_ids_sub: Off: addresses replaced with per-export hashes
strings.export_raw_warning: This export contains raw data. Anyone you share it with can see exact identifiers, places or notes.
strings.reason_movement_detail: %1$s separated locations over %2$s min · %3$s m apart · %4$s samples
strings.reason_address_stable: The same broadcast address was observed. Shared transport, radio range and coincidence can also explain this.
strings.reason_address_changeable: This address may change. Evidence applies to this address only; it does not establish a unique physical device or intent.
strings.att_not_threat: Not a threat score. It ranks what may be worth a look.
strings.att_places_note: Places are where this phone was at the time of observation.
strings.att_caveat_finder: It does not show who owns this tag or why it is nearby. A finder tag that travels with you is often yours, a companion’s, or in a shared bag. Signal strength suggests proximity only — never direction.
strings.att_caveat_generic: It does not show who owns this radio or why it is nearby. Many radios travel with people for ordinary reasons. Signal strength suggests proximity only — never direction.
strings.att_missing: This attention event is no longer on this phone.
strings.ctx_off_body: Radio awareness keeps working. Turn context sources on to see predicted satellite passes, aircraft reported by a network provider and Remote ID broadcasts this phone hears.
strings.ctx_no_location_body: Context needs a location: give the current place coordinates in Places, or allow location and turn it on.
strings.ctx_open_maps_aircraft: Open broadcast position in maps app
strings.ctx_open_maps_operator: Open operator position in maps app
strings.ctx_air_off_body: Aircraft come from OpenSky Network, not from this phone. Choose Coarse or Exact area in Context sources to ask for aircraft around you.
strings.ctx_air_rate_limited: OpenSky Network asked Sotreus to slow down. Sotreus will try again in a minute.
strings.ctx_air_network: OpenSky Network could not be reached.
strings.ctx_air_none_body: OpenSky Network reported no aircraft with a position within %1$d km. Coverage depends on volunteer receivers nearby.
strings.ctx_air_caveat_body: Positions come from %1$s’s volunteer ADS-B receivers. They can be delayed, incomplete or missing, and this phone did not observe these aircraft.
strings.ctx_air_detail_gone_body: This aircraft is not in the latest report for the selected radius.
strings.ctx_sat_off_body: Turn satellites on in Context sources to predict passes from public orbital elements.
strings.ctx_sat_no_catalog_body: Sotreus downloads orbital elements from CelesTrak once a day. Connect to the internet once; predictions then work offline.
strings.ctx_sat_refresh_failed: CelesTrak could not be reached. Predictions use the last downloaded elements.
strings.ctx_sat_caption: %1$d objects · CelesTrak elements from %2$s ago · computed on this phone
strings.ctx_sat_geo: Also %1$d geostationary, always above the horizon here: %2$s…
strings.ctx_sat_overhead_none: No moving satellites from the selected groups are above the horizon right now.
strings.ctx_sat_passes_none: No passes peaking above 10° in the next 24 hours.
strings.ctx_sat_caveat_body: Earth-observation satellite predicted overhead means only that its orbit passes over this location at that time. It does not mean the satellite imaged or observed anything here.
strings.ctx_sat_detail_missing_body: This satellite is not in the downloaded orbital elements, or there is no location to predict for.
strings.ctx_sat_detail_no_passes: No passes peaking above 10° in the next 48 hours.
strings.ctx_rid_off_body: Turn Remote ID on in Context sources to decode drone broadcasts this phone hears over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.
strings.ctx_rid_not_observing: Remote ID is decoded only while Sotreus is observing.
strings.ctx_rid_none: No Remote ID broadcasts heard right now.
strings.ctx_rid_caveat_body: Positions and IDs are what the aircraft broadcast (ASTM F3411). Sotreus cannot verify them, and a drone that does not broadcast will not appear.
strings.ctx_rid_detail_gone_body: This broadcast is no longer heard and has no stored record.
strings.ctx_sources_lead: Optional. Each item is labelled Sensed, Network or Predicted.
strings.ctx_master_sub: Off turns every source below off. Radio awareness does not need them.
strings.ctx_mode_coarse_body: Sotreus asks for a 3° × 3° box built from the 1° grid cell you are in, then filters to your radius on the phone. OpenSky never learns where in the box you are.
strings.ctx_mode_exact_body: Sotreus asks for a box just around your radius. Fewer results to download, but the request reveals your approximate location to OpenSky Network.
strings.ctx_sat_switch_sub: Orbital elements are downloaded once a day by group. Passes are computed on this phone.
strings.ctx_rid_switch_sub: Uses the Bluetooth and Wi-Fi scans Sotreus already runs. Nothing is sent.
strings.ctx_rid_region_body: Broadcast Remote ID is required for most drones in the United States (FAA Part 89) and the EU. Elsewhere many drones do not broadcast it, and some phones cannot hear Wi-Fi Remote ID beacons.
strings.ctx_sent_opensky_coarse: A 3° box, once a minute while Context is open and every 5 minutes during a session
strings.ctx_sent_opensky_exact: A box around your radius, once a minute while Context is open and every 5 minutes during a session
strings.ctx_sent_celestrak_value: The group names, once a day
strings.ctx_records: %1$d context records stored on this phone
strings.ctx_clear_body: Removes stored aircraft and Remote ID records and the downloaded orbital elements. Settings are kept.
strings.ctx_scene_a11y: Context scene. %1$s The lists below show the same items.
strings.ctx_scene_a11y_globe: Globe with %1$d predicted satellite positions around your location.
strings.ctx_scene_a11y_aircraft: %1$d aircraft reported within %2$d km, drawn around your location.
strings.ctx_scene_a11y_rid: %1$d Remote ID broadcasts drawn around your location.
strings.ctx_scene_globe_live: Predicted · live · altitude not to scale
strings.ctx_scene_globe_warp: Predicted · time-lapse ×%1$d · altitude not to scale
strings.ctx_scene_aircraft_note: Reported · %1$d km · moved on by speed and course between reports
strings.ctx_scene_no_location: Waiting for a location to place you on the globe.
strings.entity_address_static: Random static address · stays until the device restarts
strings.entity_identity_random: This radio uses a random privacy address, so its MAC can change. Sotreus links encounters while the address stays the same. The link itself is %1$s confidence.
strings.entity_identity_public: This radio uses a public factory address that stays the same. That links encounters reliably, but it still does not say who owns the device or why it is nearby.
strings.entity_identity_wifi: An access point broadcasts a stable network name and BSSID. It names the radio, not who runs it or why it is here.
strings.entity_notes_hint: Add a note — it stays on this phone
strings.entity_not_found: This entity is no longer on this phone.
strings.evidence_lead: Every stored observation for this entity, newest first. Places are where this phone was at the time of observation.
strings.evidence_coords: Phone location at time of observation: %1$s
strings.evidence_coords_masked: Phone location at time of observation: masked
strings.prox_compared: Compared with a few seconds ago
strings.prox_spark_a11y: Signal strength over the last 60 seconds. Latest %1$s dBm.
strings.prox_guidance_lead: Move slowly and pause between steps. Bodies, bags and walls change readings as much as distance does.
strings.prox_guidance_strong: Signal strength is not distance and not direction.
strings.prox_not_ble: Proximity check works on Bluetooth LE advertisers only.
strings.entity_identity_wifi_local: This BSSID is locally assigned. It may change or be shared; address continuity has low confidence.
strings.vendor_lookup_explanation: A vendor prefix can identify the address-block registrant. It does not identify an owner or exact product model.
strings.vendor_lookup_expired: Saved result has expired. Look up again to refresh.
strings.vendor_lookup_not_found: No public vendor found for this prefix.
strings.vendor_lookup_unavailable: Lookup unavailable. Local identification is still available. Try again later.
strings.vendor_lookup_retry: Please wait %1$d seconds before another lookup.
strings.vendor_lookup_unsupported: Vendor lookup is unavailable for private, locally assigned or unknown address types. Advertised company and service data can still help identify this device.
strings.vendor_lookup_consent: Send vendor prefix %1$s to api.maclookup.app. The provider also receives your IP address. Full device addresses, location, names and notes stay on your phone. Requests happen only when you tap Look up. Saved results are reused for up to 30 days. You can turn this off in Privacy.
strings.entity_stop_caveat: Where this phone heard the broadcast. Addresses are not physical identities.
strings.presence_body: When on, Sotreus broadcasts rotating anonymous tokens that only approved friends can recognise.
strings.presence_transmits: This transmits. It is separate from passive observation and needs Bluetooth advertise permission. No account, wallet or device ID is ever broadcast.
strings.presence_needs_friend: Add a friend first. Presence only broadcasts tokens for approved friends.
strings.friend_remove_body: This deletes %1$s and your shared presence secret from this phone. They will no longer be recognised nearby.
strings.friends_note: Friendship is always approved by both people — never inferred from being nearby. Your friend list is never published.
strings.friends_empty: No friends yet. Show your QR to a friend and scan theirs.
strings.qr_lead: Ask your friend to scan this in Sotreus, then scan theirs. Both of you approve by scanning.
strings.qr_contains: This code holds your display name and an app-generated presence key. No account, wallet, email or device ID.
strings.qr_a11y: QR code for adding %1$s as a friend in Sotreus
strings.qr_name_missing: Set a display name in Settings › Profile so friends know who you are.
strings.add_result_added: %1$s added. Ask them to scan your QR too.
strings.add_result_invalid: That is not a Sotreus friend code.
strings.invite_text: Add me as a friend in Sotreus: %1$s
strings.invite_confirm_body: You opened a Sotreus invite. Adding them lets your phone recognise their presence tokens. They still need to add you.
strings.h_empty_body: Entities appear here once Now has observed them. Everything stays on this phone.
strings.enc_empty_body: Encounters are stretches of time a radio was observed at a place or in a session.
strings.places_empty_body: Places are user-defined. Create one from the place picker on Now.
strings.att_empty_body: Nothing needs attention. Attention events always come with their reasons.
strings.sessions_lead: A session is an explicit window of observation. Save a route by enabling geotagging. Journey movement evidence can use location without saving the route.
strings.start_journey_sub: Observe while you move between places.
strings.start_sit_sub: Observe one room, venue or position.
strings.geotag_next_sub: Save phone coordinates with this session
strings.journey_geotag_never_note: Geotagging is off in Privacy & retention
strings.sessions_empty: No sessions yet. Start a Journey while moving or a Sit in one place.
strings.session_needs_radios: Sessions need the radio permissions, or simulated radios in Diagnostics.
strings.live_note_hint: What is happening here? It stays on this phone.
strings.summary_delete_body: This removes the session’s observations, encounters, timeline, notes, phone locations and attention events from this phone. Commitments already published on Solana are not affected. This can’t be undone.
strings.summary_missing: This session is no longer on this phone.
strings.summary_no_records: This session has no stored records to stamp.
strings.compare_caveat_body: A radio present in one sit and not the other may simply have been off, asleep, or out of range. Differences are evidence to weigh, not conclusions.
strings.compare_need_two: Compare needs two finished sits. Run another Sit in the same place to compare.
strings.summary_context_note: Happened at the same time. That does not mean they are related.
strings.journey_movement_disclosure: Journey movement evidence uses phone location while a Journey is active, including with the screen off. Saving a route is separate. Change this in Privacy.
strings.route_lead: The path shows where this phone traveled. It does not locate another radio. A map can reveal locations even when coordinate text is masked.
strings.route_empty_body: Enable live path in Field tools for an in-memory preview, or save the route during a session. Accurate GPS fixes are required. Earlier routes cannot be reconstructed when route saving was off.
strings.route_saved: Saved route · location was enabled for this session
strings.route_memory: In-memory path · route saving is separate
strings.bands_disclaimer: Rings group radios by signal strength. Where a dot sits around a ring is not its direction.
strings.bands_a11y: Proximity bands: %1$d radios grouped by signal strength. %2$d near, %3$d mid, %4$d far. %5$d new here. Positions around a ring are not directions. The List view shows the same radios.
strings.now_wifi_banner: Wi-Fi results are %1$s old. Android limits apps to 4 Wi-Fi scans every 2 minutes.
strings.now_wifi_banner_rejected: Android delayed the last Wi-Fi scan. Wi-Fi results are %1$s old and shown as stale between scans.
strings.now_simulated_banner: Simulated radios are on. These are not real observations. Turn them off in Settings › Diagnostics.
strings.now_empty_body: Nothing observable on supported bands right now. Radios that are off, asleep or out of range don’t appear.
strings.now_first_visit_body: This is the first visit, so there is no baseline yet. Familiar and changed counts start after this visit ends.
strings.now_perm_body: Android only hands scan results to apps with Nearby devices, Nearby Wi-Fi and Location permissions.
strings.now_radios_off_body: Some radios are switched off: %1$s. Results from those radios are missing.
strings.picker_note: Places are user-defined. A place learns what is normal there from your visits.
strings.picker_note_location: A place with a saved location is picked when the phone is within its radius. A place you pick here stays while the phone is near where you picked it.
strings.picker_save_location_sub: Stays on this phone. You can also pick it on a map later.
strings.picker_location_failed: The place was created without a location: no location fix was available.
strings.onb_lead: Sotreus shows what this phone can observe over Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi, learns what is normal for a place, and remembers what you have encountered before.
strings.onb_local_first_body: No account. Your radio history stays on this phone.
strings.onb_receive_only_body: Sotreus listens to broadcasts. It never pairs, joins or interferes.
strings.onb_evidence_body: A radio being present does not prove surveillance, intent or ownership. You decide what it means.
strings.onb_what_can_see: What Sotreus can and can’t see
strings.onb_no_signin: Nothing here needs sign-in. You can add a profile later in Settings.
strings.perm_lead: Android only hands scan results to apps with these permissions. Sotreus asks for what Now uses — nothing else yet.
strings.perm_nearby_body: Read Bluetooth LE advertisements. Sotreus never pairs or connects.
strings.perm_wifi_body: Read visible access-point beacons. Sotreus never joins a network.
strings.perm_location_body: Android withholds Wi-Fi and BLE results without it. Sotreus also uses it to pick saved places and assess shared movement during an active Journey, including with the screen off. Saving a route and plus-code tags are separate choices in Privacy.
strings.perm_notifications_body: A status notice while observation runs in the background.
strings.perm_not_asked_body: Bluetooth advertise — only if you turn on Nearby presence. Background location — not used in this version.
strings.perm_denied_forever: Android will not ask again. Open app settings to allow it.
strings.perm_location_off: Location is off. Android needs it on for Wi-Fi and BLE scan results.
strings.about_lead: Sotreus reports what this phone can observe. It cannot prove why a radio is there.
strings.about_can_body: Bluetooth LE advertisements and visible Wi-Fi access points that this phone’s radios receive, with their signal strength and timing. Classification comes from what each radio broadcasts, matched against a device-family catalog.
strings.about_cannot_body: Radios that are off, asleep, out of range or not advertising. Classic Bluetooth, cellular, Wi-Fi client traffic, encrypted content, and any band Android does not expose. Android also limits Wi-Fi scans to 4 every 2 minutes, so Wi-Fi results are often seconds old.
strings.about_strength_body: Signal strength suggests proximity only. Bodies, bags and walls change readings as much as distance does. Signal strength is not distance and not direction.
strings.about_identity_body: Many radios use random addresses that change. A name or family match is a pattern in the broadcast, not proof of what the device is, who owns it or why it is nearby.
strings.about_privacy_body: Observations, places, labels and notes stay on this phone. Sotreus has no observation server. Exports are privacy-reduced unless you choose otherwise.
strings.about_credits_body: Radio parsing, device explanations, the signature catalog and proximity logic are ported from Fieldwatch (MIT, Off Grid Pete LLC). Fonts: Geist, Geist Mono and Instrument Serif (SIL OFL).
strings.place_keep_learning_sub: Each visit refines what is normal here
strings.place_caveat_body: Most new radios are ordinary — a visitor’s phone, a delivery van, a neighbour’s speaker. Sotreus notes them so you can decide.
strings.place_delete_body: This removes this place’s visits, baseline, encounters, observations and attention events from this phone. The place itself, your labels and notes stay. This can’t be undone.
strings.place_delete_place_body: This removes the place and all of its history from this phone. Your entity labels and notes stay.
strings.place_missing: This place is no longer on this phone.
strings.places_lead: Places are user-defined. Each one learns what is normal there from your visits.
strings.places_empty: No places yet. Create one here or from the place picker on Now.
strings.loc_none: No location saved. A location helps you recognise the place; it never leaves this phone.
strings.loc_radius_note: Radius. While the phone is within it, Sotreus counts observations as this place, so small moves don’t split a visit.
strings.loc_no_fix: No location fix. Check that Location is on, then try again.
strings.loc_clear_body: Only the saved coordinates are removed. Visits, baseline and history stay.
strings.map_note: The map loads tiles from OpenFreeMap over the internet, which can reveal the area being shown to the tile server. Places and observations are never sent.
strings.map_a11y: Map around %1$s. The pin marks the saved location.
strings.map_picker_lead: Move the map so the pin sits on %1$s.
strings.map_picker_offline: The map couldn’t load. You can still save your current location without it.
strings.wallet_title: Connect a wallet to stamp proofs.
strings.wallet_lead: Sotreus scans without one. A wallet only signs you in and approves proof transactions.
strings.wallet_step1: Your wallet app opens on this phone.
strings.wallet_step2: You approve a Sign In With Solana message — not a transaction.
strings.wallet_step3: Sotreus keeps your public key. Keys and seed never leave the wallet.
strings.wallet_sign_kicker: You will be asked to sign
strings.wallet_no_wallet: No Solana wallet app was found on this phone.
strings.wallet_cancelled: The wallet request was declined. Nothing changed.
strings.wallet_failed: The wallet could not complete sign-in: %1$s
strings.wallet_unverified: The wallet returned a signature that did not verify, so the wallet was not linked.
strings.disconnect_note: Disconnecting keeps every local observation and proof receipt, and does not open the wallet.
strings.wallet_check_note: Sends 0 SOL to this same wallet, with the memo %1$s. Pays a mainnet network fee in SOL. Includes no observations.
strings.wallet_check_failed: The wallet check was not sent: %1$s
strings.stamping_note: Nothing is ever sent in the background. Every stamp is approved in your wallet.
strings.history_empty: No proof batches yet. End a Journey or Sit, or open a session summary to stamp it.
strings.onchain_body:
One 32-byte commitment
Your wallet address
Confirmation time
strings.never_body:
Locations · place names
SSIDs · BSSIDs · BLE addresses
Notes · tags · friends
strings.network_banner: Solana mainnet · network fees use real SOL
strings.legacy_batch: This batch belongs to a previous test network. Create a new mainnet proof from the session summary.
strings.stamp_body: This transaction commits to the integrity of %1$d locally stored records from %2$s.
strings.stamp_commitment_note: Plus your wallet address and the confirmation time.
strings.stamp_stays_body: The records, their random salts and Merkle paths, locations, place names and every radio identifier. Each record is salted before hashing so identifiers can’t be guessed back.
strings.stamp_limit_1_a: Proves these records existed in this exact form no later than confirmation. It does
strings.stamp_limit_1_b: prove where or when they were observed.
strings.stamp_limit_2: Deleting these records later will not remove the public commitment.
strings.stamp_fee_value: Final fee shown in your wallet
strings.stamp_need_wallet: Connect a wallet to approve this stamp. The batch stays pending on this phone until then.
strings.stamp_failed: The stamp was not sent: %1$s. The batch stays pending.
strings.stamp_missing: This proof batch is no longer on this phone.
strings.receipt_caveat_body: Export a single record with its salt and Merkle path. Anyone can check it against this commitment without seeing the other %1$d.
strings.wifi_note: Android allows 4 Wi-Fi scans per 2 minutes. Results between scans are shown as stale, not live.
strings.stale_after: Stale after %1$d s without a packet.
strings.simulated_radios_sub: A sample radio environment for trying the app without real radios. Turning it off deletes simulated data.
strings.force_solana_sub: Debug builds only. Lets the wallet and proof screens be tried on a non-Solana device.
strings.diagnostics_note: Diagnostics export removes radio addresses, network names, coordinates, tokens and wallet addresses.
strings.signatures_lead: Device families are matched from what each radio broadcasts. A match is a pattern in the advertisement, not proof of what the device is.
strings.signatures_source: Catalog ported from Fieldwatch (MIT, Off Grid Pete LLC). %1$d signature rows.
strings.privacy_lead: Observations, places and notes stay on this phone. Online vendor lookups are optional and send only a public prefix.
strings.keep_tagged: Keep tagged forever, expire the rest
strings.privacy_place_by_location_sub: While Sotreus is open, the place comes from the phone’s location and each saved place’s radius. Your path isn’t stored.
strings.privacy_plus_codes: Tag observations with a plus code
strings.privacy_plus_codes_sub: While Sotreus is open, each observation keeps where the phone was as a plus code, about 14 m across. This builds a location history on this phone.
strings.solana_note: Deleting local records does not remove commitments already published on Solana.
strings.confirm_session_body: This removes the session’s observations, encounters, timeline, notes, phone locations and attention events from this phone. Commitments already published on Solana are not affected.
strings.confirm_place_body: This removes this place’s visits, baseline, encounters, observations and attention events. The place itself, your labels and notes stay.
strings.confirm_presence_body: This removes your friends list, every pairwise presence secret and this phone’s presence key, and turns Nearby presence off. Friends will need to pair again.
strings.confirm_all_body: This removes every observation, encounter, place visit, session timeline entry, phone location and attention event on this phone. Your places, entity labels, names and notes stay. This can’t be undone.
strings.confirm_pending_body: This removes proof batches that were never submitted, with their salts and leaves. Finalized batches and receipts stay.
strings.profile_real_name: Real name not required. Friends see this name.
strings.profile_presence_sub: App-generated key · used only by friends
strings.profile_rotate_body: Friends will no longer recognise this phone nearby until you pair again. Your friends list stays.
strings.profile_local_note: Your profile lives on this phone. Nothing from your observation history is uploaded, and disconnecting a wallet never deletes local data.
strings.profile_disconnect_body: Sotreus forgets the wallet address and its sign-in without opening the wallet. Every local observation and proof receipt stays on this phone. To remove Sotreus from the wallet too, use the wallet’s connected apps list.
strings.privacy_journey_movement_sub: Use phone location during active Journeys, including with the screen off. Without route saving, coordinates stay in memory and only movement summaries are retained. Address rotation can break continuity.
strings.privacy_online_lookup_sub: Send only a public vendor prefix to api.maclookup.app when you tap Look up on a device. The provider sees your IP address. Full addresses and location stay on this phone.
strings.privacy_clear_vendor_cache_body: Remove all saved online vendor results. Observations, labels and local identification stay.
strings.field_tools_lead: Local evidence tools. Each location or network feature is a separate choice.
strings.field_stops_sub: Save where this phone heard a tracker with a confirmed stable identifier. Up to eight stops, for seven days. Coordinates are stored separately from routes. Unknown and rotating BLE addresses are skipped.
strings.field_clear_stops_body: Delete all saved tracker stops. Observations, labels and routes remain.
strings.field_live_path_sub: Keep a smoothed path in memory while observing. Outside a session, keep the last 15 minutes. Route saving still controls whether a path is stored.
strings.field_online_maps_sub: Load OpenFreeMap tiles when a route map is open. The map provider sees your IP address and requested map area. Offline paths work with this off.
strings.field_gnss_sub: Calibrate outdoors for one minute, standing still with a clear sky. Receiver changes can come from nearby electronics or poor reception. A warning does not locate or identify a source. Monitoring runs while observing with foreground location access.
strings.field_gnss_calibrate_first: Calibrate this phone before enabling monitoring.
strings.field_clear_calibration_body: Remove this phone’s calibration and turn GNSS monitoring off.
strings.languages_lead: Bundled community packs contain AI translations adapted from Fieldwatch. Coverage is partial; missing text stays English. Import a Sotreus template to translate additional screens. Packs stay on this phone.
strings.signatures_import_body: This changes device classifications. Existing observations, labels and the vendor database remain. Review the source of this file before importing.
strings.signatures_restore_body: Remove imported signature changes and restore bundled catalog 96. Labels, observations and vendor data remain.
strings.field_spoof_sub: Compare independent position, motion and system network-time evidence. A single mismatch does not establish spoofing.
